outline:
先修課程：3002014或負責教授同意。一維及多維穩定態熱傳導及非穩定態熱傳導、對流原理、強迫對流及自然對流經驗和實驗關係式、輻射熱傳遞、凝結與沸騰、熱交換器、熱傳遞中的特殊論題。
Steady-State Conduction-One Dimension, Steady-State Conduction-Multiple Dimensions, Unsteady-State Conduction, Principles of Convection, Empirical and Practical Relations for Forced-Convection Heat Transfer, Natural- Convection Systems, Radiation Heat Transfer, Condensation and Boiling Heat Transfer, Heat Exchangers, Special Topics in Heat Transfer.
schedule:
week 1	Heat transfer mechanisms, conservation of energy
week 2	Introduction to conduction: Fourier’s Law, general heat conduction equation, boundary and initial conditions
week 3	1D, steady-state conduction, heat generation in a solid, variable heat conductivity
week 4	Thermal resistance network: multilayer plane walls, thermal contact resistance, cylinders and spheres, finned surfaces, conduction shape factor
week 5	Transient conduction: lumped system analysis, large plane walls, spatial effects, semi-infinite solids, multidimensional systems
week 6	Numerical methods: finite difference scheme, boundary nodes
week 7	Convection: boundary layers, laminar and turbulent flow
week 8	Nondimensionalized convection equations, similarity, friction and convection coefficients, analogies between momentum and heat transfer
week 9	Midterm
week 10	External forced convection: flat plate, cylinders, spheres, tube bundle
week 11	Internal forced convection: general thermal analysis, laminar and turbulent flow in tubes
week 12	Natural convection: governing equations, Grashof number, plane and finned surfaces, enclosures
week 13	Boiling and condensation: boiling modes, pool boiling and flow boiling, film and dropwise condensation
week 15	Heat exchangers: types, log mean temperature difference method
week 16	Thermal Radiation: radiation intensity, blackbody radiation, emissivity, absorptivity, reflectivity, transmissivity
week 17	View factor, diffuse and gray surfaces
week 18	final
